objective: minutes: eliminar el indice muerto timestamp (esquema efectivo 1 -> 0) con migracion probada.
dod: npx tsc -b && npx vitest run tests/minutesDeadIndexPruneGuard.test.ts --reporter=dot

invariant.statement: minutes: los archivos cuyo esquema EFECTIVO conserva el indice muerto timestamp pasan de 1 a 0.

metric.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');let n=0;const st=['src'];const RE=/minutes:\s*[\x27]([^\x27]*)[\x27]/g;while(st.length){const d=st.pop();for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=path.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())st.push(p);else if(/[.](ts|tsx|js|jsx)$/.test(e.name)){let last=null;for(const m of fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8').matchAll(RE))last=m[1].split(',').map(s=>s.trim());if(last&&last.includes('timestamp'))n++;}}}console.log(n)"
